rationale: The plan correctly identifies the perfect confound, refuses to fit a batch term or apply ComBat-seq/SVA, and labels every result as condition+batch rather than treatment throughout. QC is thorough (blind VST, PCA, distances, library sizes, colored by both factors) with an explicit outlier-naming policy. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) and in-model median-of-ratios/TMM normalization are justified and correctly implemented, and the DESeq2/edgeR contrast, reference level, BH/apeglm shrinkage are explicit and correctly ordered. GSEA uses the full ranked list with stated metric, explicit universe, versioned collections, and size window, appropriately caveated as reflecting the confound. The final report leads with the confounding statement, states the untestable no-batch-effect assumption, and proposes rebalancing/bridging rather than computational correction, fully matching the reference standard.
